# gitmoap_repository_member (Data Source)

Get a specific repository member. Returns one person's direct role on the repository. A repository's roster is not public, even when the repository is: the caller must be signed in and able to see who has access here (Reporters and above with the built-in roles).

The token needs `repo_member:read`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo_id` (String) Repository ID
- `user_id` (String) User ID

### Read-Only

- `access_level` (String)
- `created_at` (String)
- `group_id` (String)
- `repository_id` (String)
- `visibility` (String)
